target_customer: Indian and APAC fintechs, lenders, marketplaces and SaaS companies that need banking, KYC and payments integrations
problem: Integrating with legacy Indian banks and financial institutions takes months, with poor APIs and no single point of contact. Decentro packages those integrations as modular APIs and SDKs.
business_model: Usage-based API platform for banking, payments and KYC, plus payment aggregator revenue
product_category: Banking as a service API platform

founders.name: Rohit Taneja
founders.background_notes: From the Decentro about page. Other profiles give a different sequence of roles at Wibmo, unconfirmed.

founders.name: Pratik Daudkhane
founders.background_notes: Former venture capitalist with over six years in data analytics, finance and investment banking per the about page. The YC page lists only Taneja.

competitors.name: Setu
competitors.what: API infrastructure connecting fintechs to banks, NBFCs and other regulated institutions in India
competitors.funding_then: 15M USD Series A in April 2020, after a 3.5M USD seed in 2019

technical_complexity.rationale: Standard API engineering, but the hard part is integrating and maintaining connections to many legacy banks, and later obtaining payment aggregator licensing.

defensibility.rationale: Bank relationships, an RBI authorised payment aggregator group entity and embedded integrations raise switching costs, but several funded rivals sold similar APIs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Setu was acquired by Pine Labs in 2022. No acquirer absorbed Decentro through 2025, when it raised a Series B.

market_need_then: TechCrunch's demo day coverage in August 2020 described Decentro as Plaid for India, with about 1M USD gross transaction volume, about 7,000 USD MRR, four customers and 45 more in the pipeline. India's fintech boom created demand for faster bank integrations.

branding.domain_note: Uses decentro.tech, a .tech domain rather than .com.

identity.voice_and_tone: technical and modular, with product names like Hyperstreams, Bytes, UIStreams and Scanner

branding.brand_signature: Tagline Plaid for India and APAC used in YC and press coverage

brand_strength.rationale: Press frames the company through the Plaid analogy. The company describes Decentro as a group brand for its entities. No community or merch evidence was found.

outcome_analysis: Decentro is an active API banking platform in India founded by a repeat founder who previously sold Mypoolin. It raised a seed in 2020, a 4.7M USD Series A in November 2022 and a roughly 3.6M USD Series B in June 2025 while expanding into payments and licensing, including a payment aggregator and a GIFT City licence. Funding has been modest relative to rivals, and no exit, shutdown or layoffs were found.
notes: Seed amount not disclosed. A February 2021 seed follow on is mentioned in a search summary and not verified. Series B is INR 30 crore, about 3.6M USD per outlets, reported by two outlets (Entrackr and Entrepreneur India) and Inc42. Plaid is the stated analogy, not a competitor in India. Wibmo role sequence for Taneja differs across profiles. Outcome search returned nothing about Decentro.
